messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Richard,

Defence in. As expected they plead the 1,200 mg/l design basis, the standard-terms cap at £1.48m, an exclusion of consequential loss (the £558k lost production), and a maintenance allegation. Nothing we didn't anticipate. The data-pack disclosure remains our answer on the first point. CMC is this afternoon - I'll report after.

Tom Gallagher

Tom Gallagher
